SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.label: Power Claw Form
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.description: Reorganizes the hand's nanites into a high-hardness power claw, greatly increasing melee damage.

SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.label: Mining Arm Form
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.description: Transforms the hand into a mechanical arm that speeds up mining. A built-in auger helps miners find weaknesses in rock faster. It also includes a general-purpose manipulator, which is somewhat clumsy and slightly affects mobility.

SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.label: Farming Hand Form
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.description: Transforms the hand into a mechanical palm that speeds up sowing and harvesting. Several retractable finger-like protrusions can harvest from multiple points on a plant or sow several plants at once. It also includes a general-purpose manipulator, which is somewhat clumsy and slightly affects mobility.

SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.label: Night Vision Form
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.description: Transforms the eye into a night vision system, allowing clear sight in darkness.

SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.label: Bionic Arm Form
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.description: Reconstructs the arm into a vanilla bionic arm.

SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.label: Bionic Leg Form
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.description: Reconstructs the leg into a vanilla bionic leg.

SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.label: Bionic Eye Form
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.description: Reconstructs the visual organ into a vanilla bionic eye.

SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.label: Bionic Ear Form
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.description: Reconstructs the hearing organ into a vanilla bionic ear.

SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.label: Bionic Heart Form
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.description: Reconstructs the Gray Tide core into a vanilla bionic heart.

SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.label: Bionic Jaw Form
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.description: Reconstructs the jaw into a vanilla bionic jaw.

SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.label: Bionic Tongue Form
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.description: Reconstructs the tongue into a vanilla bionic tongue.
